Method of Attack: race condition vulnerability allowing an authenticated attacker to elevate privileges to read arbitrary files protected by access control lists (ACL) on the filesystem
Attack Vector: exploitation of race condition in Microsoft Windows MsiAdvertiseProduct function
Indicators of Compromise: proof-of-concept exploit code published on GitHub (Microsoft-owned)
Date of Discovery: about one month before the micropatch release (exact date not specified)
Method of Attack: arbitrary file read vulnerability with highest privileges
